name: RNA binding motif protein 15
pathways: regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

function.text: RBM15 encodes RNA-binding protein 15. Annotated molecular activities include mRNA binding. It participates in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and RNA methylation.

function.text: RBM15 encodes RNA-binding protein 15. Based in part on similarity, it is an RNA-binding protein that acts as a key regulator of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of RNAs, thereby regulating different processes, such as hematopoietic cell homeostasis, alternative splicing of mRNAs and X chromosome inactivation mediated by Xist RNA. It contributes to m6A methylation, possibly by binding target RNAs and recruiting the WMM complex. It participates in random X inactivation mediated by Xist RNA: acts by binding Xist RNA and recruiting the WMM complex, which mediates m6A methylation, leading to target YTHDC1 reader on Xist RNA and promoting transcription repression activity of Xist.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RBM15 have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia.
